system.description:
Play the Chronicler if you want to interpret, analyse, and out-think the world around you.

Features

Adept. When you rely on an Experience, you may mark a Stress instead of spending Hope. If you do, double the Experience’s modifier for that roll.

Learned Application. When you Help an Ally with a problem where your Academic Insight is useful, roll a d6. On a 5-6, you do not need to spend a Hope.
